prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company for every Houston homeowner — the right choice depends on your location, budget, urgency (emergency vs. scheduled service), system brand/age, and whether it’s residential or commercial. I can narrow it down for you if you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is an urgent repair.

To help now, here’s a practical approach and some trusted options to consider:

What to look for
- NATE-certified technicians and a Texas HVAC license (ask to see license/ID).
- Good recent reviews on Google, Yelp, Angi and the BBB (look for many recent 4–5 star reviews).
- Clear written estimate and explanation of the problem before work begins.
- Good warranty on parts and labor.
- 24/7 emergency service if you need quick repairs.
- Transparent diagnostic/service fee and pricing structure.

Red flags
- High-pressure sales to replace the unit without clear diagnostics.
- No written estimate or vague warranty terms.
- Poor or no online reviews, or many unresolved BBB complaints.

Well-known, reputable options in Houston (you can start with these)
- John Moore Services — large local company, offers 24/7 emergency service and full HVAC/plumbing/electrical.
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, Air Conditioning & Electrical — regional provider with strong presence and good reviews.
- ABC Home & Commercial Services — national/regional chain that provides multi-trade services and maintenance plans.

(If you’d like, I can look up the top-rated companies near you now — give me your ZIP code and whether this is urgent or commercial — and I’ll return a short list with ratings, typical response times, and what customers mention in recent reviews.)
